title: 第十一章 中级妖兽 火纹豹第十二章 绝美女修
content_zh:
这次的雨整整下了一天一夜，直到第二天晚上才慢慢停了下来。
柳辰索性就在山洞中多呆了一晚上，毕竟晚上赶路可不是什么好选择。
转天早晨天刚刚亮，柳辰简单吃过早饭带上一些昨天烤好的熊肉就出发了。
此时他的伤都已经止血，一些不严重的甚至已经结伽。
虽然真气可以在一定程度上修复伤势，但是这也是需要时间的，尤其是胸口疾风狼留下的那道伤口。
虽然有内甲的保护，但是狼爪还是穿透了内甲，划开了皮肤，虽然伤口不是很深，但是狼爪上的风属性能量还是影响了伤口的恢复速度。
这次柳辰并不打算继续往山脉深处走，远处时不时传来的兽吼声，无不在告诉柳辰接下来的路程有多么危险。
柳辰打算往回走，只要走出山脉，找到城镇，自己才算真正脱险。
他可不认为自己可以横穿整个元妖山脉。
虽然他不知道自己在什么地方，但他知道一直往南走就一定能走出山脉。
当然他不会直接原路返回，他会先往西有一大段然后再往南走，这样既可以避开身后的追兵，又可以保证自己回到的是元山王国境内。
接下来的行程可不轻松，柳辰既要抹除自己的踪迹又要小心提防着敌人。
不管是妖兽还是血杀小队，都不是现在自己能够应付的。
而且自己身上的符篆灵石甚至是疗伤药等资源都已经使用殆尽了，在碰上什么危险就只能靠自己硬抗了。
-------------
“我们该回去了，我会跟郡主请罪，承担这次的责任”
血一拦住想要继续出去寻找柳辰的血三。
他们已经在雨停后又找了两天时间，这次他们没有一起，而是两个人一组分散出去。
虽然还是没有找到柳辰的踪迹，好在没有再有人员损伤。
至于找不到柳辰这也在他的意料之中，毕竟山脉太大了，不是他们十几个人能转遍的。

而且时间也不允许了，再不走，他们就真的走不了了。
“这次我也有责任，受罚也算我一份”
好在血三虽然狂妄，但是还是比较听他这个队长的话的。
除了他在血杀中的排名比血三高外，还有就是接近高级武徒的实力能够压服他。
越是狂妄，变态的人，越崇拜强者。
“回去再说吧，血二受伤不轻，你要保护好他，我担心回去的路上碰到疾风狼，这次我们损失太了”
血一有些担心的说道。
要知道，狼是一种很记仇的生物，妖兽狼更是如此。
“好，这次他如果敢出现的话，我会要它的命”
血三恶狠狠的说道。
血二跟他的关系不错，可以说整个血杀小队的关系都不错。
“出发....”
血一再次看了眼这个让他遭受一生中最大败笔的地方，领着一行人以特有的队形向山脉外走去。
—————
“吼...”
“靠，这也太倒霉了吧”
柳辰脸色有些难看的看了眼百米外的小山头，低声骂了一句。
content_en:
This time it rained all day and all night, and it slowly stopped until the second night.
Liu Chen simply stayed in the cave for one more night. After all, traveling at night was not a good choice.
The next morning it was just dawn. Liu Chen had a simple breakfast and took some bear meat roasted yesterday and set off.
By this time, his injuries had stopped bleeding, and some of the less serious ones had even become knotted.
Although true energy can repair injuries to a certain extent, it also takes time, especially the wound left by the Wind Wolf on the chest.
Although protected by the inner armor, the wolf claws still penetrated the inner armor and cut open the skin. Although the wound was not very deep, the wind energy on the wolf claws still affected the recovery speed of the wound.
This time Liu Chen did not intend to continue walking deeper into the mountains. The roars of beasts from far away told Liu Chen how dangerous the next journey would be.
Liu Chen planned to go back. Only when he got out of the mountains and found a town could he truly be out of danger.
He didn't think he could cross the entire Yuanyao Mountain Range.
Although he didn't know where he was, he knew that if he kept going south, he would be able to get out of the mountains.
Of course, he will not directly return the same way. He will first go west for a long distance and then go south. This way he can avoid the pursuers behind him and ensure that he returns to the Yuanshan Kingdom.
The next trip will not be easy. Liu Chen must not only erase his traces but also be careful of his enemies.
Whether it's a monster or a blood-killing team, it's not something I can handle right now.
Moreover, all the resources such as Talisman Spiritual Stones and even healing medicines on his body have been used up. If he encounters any danger, he can only rely on himself to resist it.
-------------
"We should go back. I will plead guilty to the princess and bear the responsibility for this time."
Xue Yi stopped Xue San who wanted to continue looking for Liu Chen.
They had been looking for two more days after the rain stopped, and this time they spread out in groups of two instead of together.
Although there was still no trace of Liu Chen, fortunately there were no further injuries.
As for not being able to find Liu Chen, this was something he expected. After all, the mountain range was too big for more than a dozen of them to cover.
And time doesn't allow it. If they don't leave, they really won't be able to leave.
"I am also responsible this time, and I will be punished."
Fortunately, although Xue San is arrogant, he still listens to what he, the captain, says.
In addition to his ranking higher than Blood Three in blood killing, there is also the fact that his strength is close to that of a high-level martial artist who can overwhelm him.
The more arrogant and perverted people are, the more they worship the strong.
"Let's talk about it after we go back. Xuer Er is seriously injured. You have to protect him. I'm worried about encountering the Storm Wolf on the way back. We have suffered too much loss this time."
Xueyi said worriedly.
You know, wolves are very vengeful creatures, especially monster wolves.
"Okay, if he dares to show up this time, I will kill him."
Xue San said fiercely.
Blood 2 has a good relationship with him, and it can be said that the entire Blood Killing Team has a good relationship.
"Let's go..."
Xueyi once again looked at the place where he suffered the biggest failure in his life, and led a group of people in a unique formation to walk outside the mountains.
—————
"Roar..."
"Damn, this is so unlucky."
Liu Chen glanced at the hilltop a hundred meters away with an ugly expression, and cursed in a low voice.
